scenario.summary: Searches a keyword that has a search boost rule and verifies the boosted product is listed first (name and SKU).
steps: Go home, refresh, search the keyword
Verify the first product's name and SKU
assertions: First listed product is the boosted product
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser signs in with loginPage.customerSuccessfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/productListingPageTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B179/C179) and the later methods of the class (priority 100-125) run in that signed-in session until productListingPageLoggOffTheUser. Convention: every method that signs in or reuses the signed-in session declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true} (Tda.declareUser -> useExisting). Username/password stay credential sources (masked); the scanner recorded them only on the sign-in method, later methods declare the same two cells from the test source (the session they reuse).

boost = SEARCH_RULE_PRODUCT_OF_KEYWORD (NEW key, pending) {store, ruleEffect boost}: an active, not paused search catalog rule of the store's catalog whose trigger matches the keyword and whose item rule boosts one product. No existing key covers search rules (entity map search_rule and query written 2026-11-10, pending; rule 1 'Boost' of catalog 5 triggers on 'bosch' and boosts z-2430003 by 99, buries z-2460005 with 0.11: boost = item boost value above 1, bury = below 1). Preferred: the sheet SKU boostAndBury!B150 z-2430003, not required. Runs in the signed-in session of verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser (declares the account, see DECLARED ACCOUNT).

verifyProductBuried (next method, no dependsOn) checks the last product of the SAME search results without searching again: first method captures, so this method also declares bury = SEARCH_RULE_PRODUCT_OF_KEYWORD {store, ruleEffect bury, keyword @boost.keyword} and the two bury values (boostAndBury!B152/B153, declared from verifyProductBuried's source).
Sheet values: SearchKeyword1 'bosch' -> boost.keyword, BoostedProductName -> boost.productName, BoostedProductSku -> boost.productSku.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
